quote.text: I am composed of the formal and the material; and neither of them will perish into non-existence, as neither of them came into existence out of non-existence. Every part of me then will be reduced by change into some part of the universe, and that again will change into another part of the universe, and so on for ever.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that both the nature and the nurture of a child are integral to their being, much like the interplay of form and substance in the universe. This teaches us that every influence shapes their enduring spirit.
    • Embrace the inevitability of change in a child's growth; as they evolve, remember that each stage contributes to the ever-changing tapestry of life, echoing the eternal transformation of all that exists.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that every leader is composed of enduring principles and the immediate actions taken every day. Just as nothing perishes but transforms, a leader’s influence continues to ripple through the fabric of time.
    • Accept that change is inherent in any organization; like parts of the universe, team members and ideas continually evolve. Cultivate a mindset that harnesses change to strengthen the unity and purpose of your collective endeavor.
  • Product Management
    • Reflect on how each product is formed from ideas (the formal) and resources (the material), mirroring the quote’s notion of eternal components. This perspective can help you value both the conceptual vision and the practical details.
    • Embrace iterative change in development; every version is a transformation that contributes to a greater whole. Recognize that continuous adaptation and evolution are as natural as the cycles within the universe itself.
